rca of the issue: ReferenceError SUGGESTED_CITIES on /onboarding/creator. Root cause: developer wrote the datalist JSX (`{SUGGESTED_CITIES.map(...)}`) but forgot to declare the constant. React tried to render the component, JS threw ReferenceError, react-error-boundary surfaced the red overlay. Reproduction: sign up as creator → navigate to /onboarding/creator → red overlay 'SUGGESTED_CITIES is not defined'. Mitigation: added `const SUGGESTED_CITIES = [...12 cities]` at module scope in CreatorOnboarding.jsx. Post-fix verified: page renders, datalist populated with 12 options, city persists across PUT+reload.
